title: Round Midnight Original Soundtrack CD Herbie Hancock Dexter Gordon 1986
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Round Midnight - Original Motion Picture Soundtrack
(Columbia CK 40464, 1986). Soundtrack produced by Herbie Hancock.
The Bertrand Tavernier film starring Dexter Gordon.

Featuring Bobby McFerrin, Chet Baker, Dexter Gordon, Tony Williams,
Freddie Hubbard, Billy Higgins, Herbie Hancock, Bobby Hutcherson,
Ron Carter, John McLaughlin, Lonette McKee, Pierre Michelot,
Wayne Shorter, Cedar Walton and others.

1. Round Midnight (5:35)
2. Body And Soul (5:54)
3. Berangere's Nightmare (3:06)
4. Fair Weather (6:05)
5. Una Noche Con Francis (4:22)
6. The Peacocks (7:16)
7. How Long Has This Been Going On? (3:12)
8. Rhythm-A-Ning (4:11)
9. Still Time (3:50)
10. Minuit Aux Champs-Elysees (3:26)
11. Chan's Song (Never Said) (4:15)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
